suggestions.rationale: Herniated or bulging discs (IVDS) frequently compress adjacent nerve roots, causing radiating pain, tingling, and weakness into the arms or legs.
evidenceGaps: EMG/Nerve Conduction Study confirming nerve root impingement

suggestions.rationale: Severe lower lumbar disc compression (Cauda Equina Syndrome) can compromise the nerves controlling bowel and bladder function.
evidenceGaps: Neurological confirmation of sacral nerve root compression
